name: Just Deserts
source:
Just Deserts is a sci-fi action dating sim where you play as a soldier who must protect a city from mysterious alien attack, while at the same time need to capture the heart of your dream girl(s)!

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/488660]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Just Deserts》是一款科幻动作恋爱模拟游戏。你将扮演一名士兵，在保护城市免受神秘外星人袭击的同时，努力赢得梦中女孩们的芳心！

[来源：[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/488660]Steam[/url]]
